'''Vale''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located in the [[Vale system/Legends|Vale system]], a part of the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]], a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that included the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and hero [[Shea Hublin]], [[Air Marshal]] of the [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Greater Seswenna]] region, was [[Ambush at Vale|ambushed]] at Vale by anti-Imperial rebels. In the ensuing confrontation, Hublin lost a [[Limb/Legends|leg]] and a half of his arm and later transferred from the Imperial [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] and instead took up a line [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Kabalian Cross]]''.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vale was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vale [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square L-19.<ref name="EAOC" />
